pos.personaBrief: Zidane spoke of possession and speed and Madrid had 55-65% of the ball in early 2016, yet the sources describe counters through explosive wide players and sitting back to absorb pressure (Atletico games, Real Champs). A pragmatic mix: possession used for control, but danger from transitions.

pro.personaBrief: Build-up with Kroos dropping between centre-backs and playing out from the back, Casemiro as a safe pivot, but quick counters through the wings and Bale/Ronaldo directness.

est.personaBrief: No single identity: 4-3-3, diamond or flat 4-4-2 without predilection, free positional interchange, Ronaldo in a free role, Isco roaming, fluid midfield. Strikers like Benzema drop to link, wide players come inside.

lar.personaBrief: Width came from attacking full-backs Marcelo and Carvajal and from Bale and Lucas, with crosses; but the diamond with Isco put the best creators centrally and Zidane readily chose an extra midfielder over wingers.

blo.personaBrief: Pressing was phase and opponent dependent: high press in the 2016 Clasico and counterpress with a unit of five, but Ronaldo and Benzema barely pressed and Madrid often waited in two compact lines (Atletico 2016, Real Champs).

mar.personaBrief: Zonal base with man-orientations in 2016, and strict man-marking of Messi by Casemiro or Kovacic in the 2017 Clasico and Supercopa, so dedicated markers on stars with a zonal default.

pla.personaBrief: Zidane adapted to opponents (diamond against three-at-the-back sides, man-marking Barca, pressing higher at half-time of the Juventus final), reverted to the Ancelotti way rather than imposing a model, and said no formation is particular.

res.personaBrief: Three Champions Leagues; pragmatic and flexible, with an attacking star-filled side that still plays to win, and defensive reinforcement against Barca; results first, spectacle as by-product.

sis.personaBrief: Talent-led: Zidane stated he is not the best tactician, gave stars free roles, spared Ronaldo for big games and trusted Benzema; Ronaldo and Bale were not forced to track back, and player quality was key.

jog.personaBrief: Technical midfield of Kroos, Modric, Isco with Casemiro as a disciplined but passing-capable pivot; physical intensity matters but quality on the ball decides.

bas.personaBrief: Built on proven stars and signings, same midfield for three titles; rotation brought in Lucas, Asensio, Kovacic but the core was experienced winners.

lid.personaBrief: Man-management and empathy: Zidane talks to players, explains his thinking, keeps no egos, and told Ronaldo to save himself; stars are not untouchable but get more minutes.
